title: ORDER BY
description: Sort result sets with ORDER BY, NULLS FIRST/LAST, and collation.

data.text: ORDER BY sorts rows. Use ASC or DESC, NULLS FIRST/LAST, and collations for text.

data.title: Sorting
data.content: Sort by multiple columns with NULLS LAST
data.code:
SELECT id, name, completed_at
FROM tasks
ORDER BY completed_at NULLS LAST, name COLLATE "en_US" ASC
LIMIT 100;

data.title: Performance
data.text: ORDER BY can use indexes on large tables.

data.title: Exercise: Sort Tasks
data.description: Sort tasks by completion status and name.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use indexes for sorting large sets.
